name: Time Wise Sales
query:
SELECT
    time_intervals.`Time Interval`,
    COALESCE(SUM(sales_by_interval.`Sales`), 0) AS 'Sales',
    COUNT(sales_by_interval.`Bill`) AS 'Bills'
FROM (
    SELECT '12 AM - 02 AM' AS 'Time Interval', 1 AS 'Order'
    UNION ALL SELECT '02 AM - 04 AM', 2
    UNION ALL SELECT '04 AM - 06 AM', 3
    UNION ALL SELECT '06 AM - 08 AM', 4
    UNION ALL SELECT '08 AM - 10 AM', 5
    UNION ALL SELECT '10 AM - 12 PM', 6
    UNION ALL SELECT '12 PM - 02 PM', 7
    UNION ALL SELECT '02 PM - 04 PM', 8
    UNION ALL SELECT '04 PM - 06 PM', 9
    UNION ALL SELECT '06 PM - 08 PM', 10
    UNION ALL SELECT '08 PM - 10 PM', 11
    UNION ALL SELECT '10 PM - 12 AM', 12
) AS time_intervals
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '00:00:00' AND '01:59:59' THEN '12 AM - 02 AM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '02:00:00' AND '03:59:59' THEN '02 AM - 04 AM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '04:00:00' AND '05:59:59' THEN '04 AM - 06 AM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '06:00:00' AND '07:59:59' THEN '06 AM - 08 AM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:59:59' THEN '08 AM - 10 AM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '10:00:00' AND '11:59:59' THEN '10 AM - 12 PM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '12:00:00' AND '13:59:59' THEN '12 PM - 02 PM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '14:00:00' AND '15:59:59' THEN '02 PM - 04 PM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '16:00:00' AND '17:59:59' THEN '04 PM - 06 PM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '18:00:00' AND '19:59:59' THEN '06 PM - 08 PM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '20:00:00' AND '21:59:59' THEN '08 PM - 10 PM'
            WHEN TIME(`creation`) BETWEEN '22:00:00' AND '23:59:59' THEN '10 PM - 12 AM'
        END AS 'Time Interval',
        `name` AS "Bill",
        `grand_total` AS 'Sales'
    FROM `tabPOS Invoice`
    WHERE 
        DATE(`creation`) = DATE(%(date)s)
        AND `branch` = %(branch)s
        AND `docstatus` = 1
        AND `status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid")
) AS sales_by_interval
ON time_intervals.`Time Interval` = sales_by_interval.`Time Interval`
GROUP BY time_intervals.`Time Interval`
ORDER BY time_intervals.`Order`;
